description: This file contains unit tests for the NonGmailSentFolderHandler class, which manages the process of storing emails in sent folders for non-Gmail accounts within the SuiteCRM project. It includes test methods for error handling, protocol conditions, and connection logic.

classes.name: NonGmailSentFolderHandlerTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test case class testing the functionality of NonGmailSentFolderHandler, including error handling, protocol checks, and server connection logic.

methods.name: testClearLastError
methods.description: Tests that clearLastError resets the last error to null.

methods.name: testSetLastErrorNoInt
methods.description: Checks that setLastError throws an InvalidArgumentException when passing a non-integer.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderNoIEIsNull
methods.description: Verifies behavior when storeInSentFolder is called with a null inbound email object.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderNoIE
methods.description: Tests storeInSentFolder behavior when no inbound email object is provided.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderIsPop3
methods.description: Ensures storeInSentFolder fails when the inbound email protocol is POP3.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderIsGmail
methods.description: Tests that storeInSentFolder correctly handles Gmail SMTP type.

methods.name: storeInSentFolderOk
methods.description: Checks successful conditions for storeInSentFolder with valid protocol and SMTP type.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderNoIEID
methods.description: Validates message when IE ID is not set.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderNoIEIDValue
methods.description: Validates message when IE ID is set but empty.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderIsPop3
methods.description: Validates message when the protocol is POP3.

methods.name: testGetProblemOfStoringInNonGmailSentFolderIsGmail
methods.description: Validates message when the email is of type Gmail.

methods.name: testConnectToNonGmailServer
methods.description: Tests the connectToNonGmailServerPublic method, including exception handling for invalid argument types.
